title: Inanimate Insanity | Light Shimmer Spears Texture Pack
description: Cool Inanimate Insanity themed texture pack for the minecraft spears!
body: I made this texture pack for fun and I honestly like how it came out. It's meant to retexture + rename the spears into light shimmer spears and I made the netherite spear into a darmk matter version of a shimmer spear just for the fun of it.
